title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 132
description: Ten questions on Psalms 132: David's vow to find a place for Yahweh, the ark and Yahweh's oath to David about Zion.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh to remember in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:1 says, "Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction."

questions.text: To whom did David vow, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:2 says he swore to Yahweh and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob.

questions.text: What did David swear he would not give to his eyes?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:4 says, "I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids."

questions.text: Until what would David keep this vow?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:5 says, "until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

answers.text: Until he found a place for Yahweh
Until he had defeated his enemies
Until he had built a palace for himself

questions.text: Where does verse 6 say "we heard of it"?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:6 says, "Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah."

questions.text: Where do they say they will worship in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:7 says, "We will worship at his footstool."

questions.text: Together with whom or what is Yahweh asked to arise into his resting place?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:8 says, "Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength."

questions.text: What did Yahweh swear to David in truth?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:11 says, "I will set the fruit of your body on your throne."

answers.text: To give him a land of rest
To set the fruit of his body on his throne
To make his name like the stars
To build him a house of cedar

questions.text: What has Yahweh chosen and desired for his habitation?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:13 says, "For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation."

questions.text: With what will Yahweh satisfy Zion's poor?
questions.explanation: Psalms 132:15 says, "I will satisfy her poor with bread."
